top_signals.title: US Jobless Claims Hit Three-Month Low at 194,000
top_signals.summary: Applications for US unemployment benefits fell by 6,000 to 194,000 last week, a three-month low. The median forecast of economists polled by Bloomberg called for 200,000. Continuing claims rose to a six-week high of 1.73 million in the previous week. Michael McKee reports on Bloomberg Television. (Source: Bloomberg)

top_signals.summary: German football giants Bayern Munich have been valued at £3.1bn after taking minority investment from long-standing sponsor Viessmann Generations Group.
